changes: Repair consult e-sign redesign: removed one-click office-approve and email-approval flows
New two-stage signature flow: client e-signs (status -> pending_countersignature) then admin countersigns to finalize
Mark Signed (print & sign path) now requires uploaded evidence photo/PDF, then a separate Confirm Print-Signed step by admin before finalizing
New public Decline route for clients to decline a repair proposal

On full execution (countersign OR confirm-print-signed), auto-generates signed agreement PDF + Work Order & Final Checklist PDF, archives permanently to repair_consult_archives, and emails Work Order to client + admins with start date, deadline, materials, and full scope in chronological order
Admin panel: merged dual PDF-view buttons into one View Quote button, added Signature Stage column, added evidence-upload flow for Mark Signed

HOTFIX: Listing Consult Scope Photos were also being duplicated into Walk-Through Photos on every upload. Fixed going forward; added /api/admin/db-repair/dedupe-listing-consult-photos to clean up already-affected consults
__bundleNotes: officeApprove (camelCase function/handler name) and the old one-click 'Approve Proposal' button copy are retired in v20.32.1 — their presence in the live bundle would mean the old build is still being served. countersign/Signature Stage/Decline Proposal/Awaiting Countersign are new v20.32.0 UI strings that must be present.
